10 استفلى رَأْسَهُ , and ↓ تفالى , (S, K,) i. e. تفالى هُوَ [not تفالى رأسه], (S,) He desired that his head might be searched for lice. (S, K.) ＝
-A2- And استفلاهُ He exposed himself to have his head struck and cut with the sword: (M, TA:) a poet says, “أَمَاتَرَانِى رَابِطَ الجَنَانِ
أَفْلِيهِ بِالسَّيْفِ إِذَا ٱسْتَفْلَانِى
” [Dost thou not see me to be strong of heart? I will strike and cut his head with the sword when he exposes himself to be so struck &c.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
